contract_type_description.project_based: A defined scope with a start and end date, delivered by one professional or a small team. Priced per project or per month for the duration.

home.heroTitle: Vetted Colombian talent for US teams, hired in days
home.heroSubtitle: Dexee recruits, employs and manages bilingual professionals in Colombia. Same hours as your office, with guarantees you can sign.
home.intentJob: I am looking for a remote job
home.intentAssess: I want my English level assessed
home.timelineToday: Post the role. Tell us the profile, the contract type and the budget.
home.timelineDays: Receive a Dexee-vetted shortlist with verified English levels and work-style profiles.
home.timelineWeeks: Hire and onboard through Dexee: contracts, payroll and compliance handled in Colombia.
home.serviceHeadhuntingBody: Direct hire and executive search for leadership and specialist roles. Shortlist in weeks, replacement guarantee included.
home.serviceStaffAugBody: Dedicated professionals who work exclusively for you on US hours. Dexee is the legal employer in Colombia and handles payroll, benefits and compliance.
home.serviceEnglishBody: Written and oral screening mapped to CEFR levels. Oral results are validated by Dexee reviewers before they reach a company.
home.serviceWorkstyleBody: A screening of working preferences and remote-work judgment. Candidates decide whether companies see the summary.
home.ctaBody: We tell you within a week whether we can fill the role, and at what cost.
home.guarantee1: Replacement at no cost if a hire does not fit within the agreed period.
home.guarantee2: Contracted SLAs for response times and communication channels.
home.guarantee3: Labor, tax and data-protection compliance in each jurisdiction.
home.guarantee4: Confidentiality agreements and least-privilege access by design.

companies.heroTitle: Hire skilled professionals in Colombia without adding US payroll
companies.heroSubtitle: Post the role, review a vetted shortlist and choose the contract that fits. Dexee handles sourcing, screening, local employment and compliance.
companies.value1Body: Colombia runs on US Central and Eastern time all year. English C1 minimum in client-facing roles.
companies.value2Body: Senior professionals in finance, engineering, support and operations, selected against your profile.
companies.value3Body: Replacement at no cost, contracted SLAs, audits and KPI reporting, confidentiality and compliance.
companies.value4Body: One monthly rate that includes salary, benefits and management. Salaries shown in USD per month.
companies.how1Body: We map the role, define the profile and agree the terms.
companies.how2Body: A shortlist of vetted candidates with verified English levels and work-style profiles.
companies.how3Body: Contracts, equipment, access and a 30-day integration plan.
companies.how4Body: Monthly KPI reporting and a named account lead.
companies.pricingBody: Pricing depends on the role, the contract type and the seniority. Talk to us and we will send a quote within a week.
companies.faq1Q: How long does it take to receive a shortlist?
companies.faq1A: Typically between one and three weeks depending on the profile. You see applicants in your pipeline as they are vetted.
companies.faq2Q: When do I see a candidate's contact details?
companies.faq2A: After Dexee releases them for a specific application. Until then you see the professional profile, assessment badges and a first name.
companies.faq3A: It depends on the contract type. With Dexee as employer of record, Dexee hires in Colombia and bills you monthly. With direct hire or contractor, your company contracts the professional.
companies.faq4Q: What happens if the hire does not work out?
companies.faq4A: Every engagement includes a replacement guarantee within the agreed period, at no additional cost.
companies.faq5A: Yes. Written results are automatic; oral results are validated by Dexee reviewers. Badges show the lower of the two levels.
companies.ctaBody: Create a company account, post the vacancy and receive vetted applicants. Dexee verifies companies within one business day.

talent.heroTitle: Remote roles with US companies, from Colombia
talent.heroSubtitle: Build your profile once, take three free assessments and apply. Dexee protects your contact details until a company is serious.
talent.value1Body: Every vacancy shows the contract type and, in most cases, the monthly salary range in US dollars.
talent.value2Body: Companies see your profile and badges. Email, phone and resume are released by Dexee only when a company moves forward.
talent.value3Title: Formal employment when you want it
talent.value3Body: For Dexee as employer of record roles you get a Colombian employment contract with benefits, paid by Dexee.
talent.assessmentsIntro: Results attach to your profile as Dexee screening badges. They are not certifications.
talent.assessWrittenBody: 40 questions on grammar, vocabulary and reading plus one short writing task. 45 minutes. Automatic CEFR level.
talent.assessOralBody: Four recorded answers of 60 to 90 seconds. A Dexee reviewer validates the level, which then appears as verified.
talent.assessWorkstyleBody: Fifty statements and ten remote-work situations. You receive a full report and decide whether companies see a summary.
talent.assessmentsReceive1: A CEFR level for written and oral English, with feedback.
talent.assessmentsReceive2: A work-style report with your strengths for remote work.
talent.assessmentsReceive3: Badges on your profile that companies can trust.
talent.how1: Complete your profile and upload a PDF resume.
talent.how2: Apply to a role with one click and an optional note.
talent.how3: Track each application through screening, interview and offer.
talent.how4: Dexee releases your contact details when a company moves forward.
talent.faq1A: Yes. Companies pay Dexee. You never pay for assessments or placements.
talent.faq2Q: How often can I retake an assessment?
talent.faq2A: Once every 90 days per assessment. Your best current result stays on your profile.
talent.faq3Q: Can I hide my work-style profile?
talent.faq3A: Yes. It is hidden from companies by default and you can change that at any time in Settings.
talent.faq4A: Only what a hiring process needs: professional experience, skills, contact details and assessment results. Never photos, age or other protected characteristics.
talent.ctaBody: It takes about ten minutes. You can pause and continue later.

about.heroTitle: The nearshore talent and back-office partner for US growth companies
about.heroSubtitle: From Barranquilla, Colombia, Dexee recruits, employs and manages bilingual professionals through three services: Dexee Search, Dexee Teams and Dexee Back Office.
about.purposeBody: Dexee exists so a company in the United States can hire, employ and operate teams in Colombia as naturally as it would in its own city.
about.promiseBody: Talent ready, risk covered. Every engagement carries a replacement guarantee, contracted SLAs and KPI reporting. Clients buy operating capacity, not a bet.
about.searchBody: Direct hire and executive search for leadership and specialist roles. Replacement guarantee.
about.teamsBody: Dedicated professionals who work exclusively for the client. Dexee is the employer in Colombia.
about.backOfficeBody: Managed processes: finance and accounting, administration, customer support, legal and compliance support, against SLAs.
about.value2Body: Clear about scope, price and limits. We say within a week whether we can help.
about.value3Body: Warm and accessible. Caribbean warmth is a real asset.
about.value4Body: Every commitment has a written guarantee. If something fails, we replace it at no cost.
about.why1: 0 to 1 hour difference with US Eastern and Central time, all year.
about.why2: A growing bilingual talent hub with lower cost than Bogotá or Medellín.
about.why3: Formal employment, legal compliance and continuity for every hire.
